title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：mixture　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mixture 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1980 the researcher ① stirred the mixture that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the stirring was the whole of the term. The ② mixture, meaning the blend itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; a mixture, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ mixture in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ mixture at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A mixture, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the mixture was the whole of the matter, meaning the balance and not the blend. The ⑥ mixture, meaning the balance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; mixture, he said, is either something you stir or the only word that means both a blend and a balance. He said the balance is the part they remember.

By 1985 the ⑦ mixture had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ mixture of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; mixture, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ mixture I remember is the blend noted in the paper, which closed in 1987 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ mixture, my mother said in 1989, is the only blend that improves by being noted; every mixture, she said, is a balance that has agreed to look like a blend. She said the balance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 混合；混合物（指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 混合；混合物（指那种混合本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：stir the mixture 搅这一种混合
D. n. 混合；混合物（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 混合之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的混合之事）
F. n. 混合；混合物（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 混合、调和（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 调和（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: stirred the mixture that no student in the lab would have noted
The mixture, meaning the blend itself and not the tube
the mixture at the far bench
the mixture was the whole of the matter

answers.why: stir the mixture 意为“搅这一种混合”，1980 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种混合做了一遍。
mixture 意为“混合；混合物”，指那种混合本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
mixture 意为“混合；混合物”，指实验室里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
mixture 意为“混合；混合物”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
mixture 意为“混合、调和”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种调和就是那件事的全部。
mixture 意为“调和”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种混合，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
mixture 意为“混合；混合物”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1985 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
mixture 意为“混合之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的混合之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
mixture 意为“混合；混合物”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一种，1987 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
mixture 为抽象总称，母亲 1989 年说，混合是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的混合。
